card.title: Hero gear
card.description: Every hero wears all {{pieces}} pieces. Their level is your Hero Enhancement research ({{research}}/{{max}}, in the Academy); stars are bought with medals. A hero uses gear levels and stars up to its gear tier: none at hero levels 1-9, 1 at 10-19, … 9 at 90-99, all {{max}} at level {{heroMaxLevel}}. A piece at level L adds 1 + … + L points, each star +{{starPoints}}.
card.levelZero: Your gear is level 0: only stars count until you research Hero Enhancement in the Academy (level N needs Academy level N).
card.starsAboveHint: Stars above your Hero Enhancement level count once you research it
card.starNeedsResearchWaiting_one: Star {{star}} needs Hero Enhancement level {{star}} (now {{level}}); only {{used}} of the {{count}} star counts until then
card.starNeedsResearchWaiting_other: Star {{star}} needs Hero Enhancement level {{star}} (now {{level}}); only {{used}} of the {{count}} stars count until then
